QF.id: VB Concept and Role of Mutual Fund_20

question.text: What is the main purpose of a New Fund Offer (NFO)?

answer.text: To launch a new mutual fund scheme and collect initial investment from investors
To offer existing scheme units at a discounted price
To merge two existing mutual fund schemes
To return money to existing investors

explanation.text: The Logic: An NFO is the first-time offer of units when an AMC launches a brand new mutual fund scheme. NFO units are typically offered at face value of Rs. 10. NFOs other than ELSS can remain open for a maximum of 15 days. The Trap: An NFO is not a discount sale of existing schemes. NFO units at Rs. 10 are not "cheaper" — the face value simply reflects that the fund has not yet generated any returns. Note: The 15-day outer limit (for non-ELSS NFOs) and the Rs. 10 face value come from the cited workbook pages.
